source_evidence.quote: I need two independent fault reports preserved accurately, the escalation evidence package actually delivered through an authorized route, a safe public service-status note, a live-class repair handout, the instructor’s independent cached demonstration copy repaired, the private incident ledger, and a final private receipt handover to me. The instructor must receive the first approved demonstration and handout before preparation starts, even if the scheduled repair audit later changes a step. Do not merge the two reporters’ experiences into one claimed reproduction. If the audit changes the demonstration, repair its actual configuration and every affected held/cached/printed teaching copy before class. Historical fault reports remain evidence; do not rewrite their observations to match a later workaround.

Jo observed intermittent local autosave stalls on the desktop DriveDesk client. It affected a draft only; Jo did not report a cloud upload timeout. Reproduction should record local autosave behavior without claiming every user is affected.
Kit observed cloud upload timeouts on the browser DriveDesk client, with no local autosave stall observed. This is an independent report, not confirmation of Jo’s exact symptom.

One test workstation performs report A reproduction, report B reproduction and demo test runs,10 minutes each, one at a time. The report writer takes4 minutes; the print desk takes6 minutes. A final demo proof must reflect the current workaround, and handout/cache must carry that actual proof. Current teaching copies can change while historical incident evidence stays unchanged.
